name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.233.0 — Derived prototype tests no longer land on the host's main branch. The session now writes the end-to-end tests in the prototype worktree and commits them on proto/<stem>; the freeze verifies the committed file, refuses a stray copy in the main working tree or uncommitted edits, runs the host's test list from the worktree, and carries the file onto harden/<stem> as a second commit, so a working branch only gets the red tests through the hardening spec's own merge. Generated specs now say where their tests are. 7.232.0 — Prototype freeze: a re-run of the tests-derived mark (the designed path after the risk-tier stop) no longer writes every exported file as MODIFY in the generated spec's File Plan. Each exported file's action is now read from the prototype branch's own diff, so a deleted file is a DELETE row and an added file a CREATE row on the first run and on every resume. 7.231.0 — One port per launch (20261005/03): smoke.sh gives every run of a host whose readyCheck reads $PORT its own free loopback port and exports it as PORT; prototype.url may carry {port}, and the prototype and build drivers keep one port per prototype/build, print PORT=<n> <bootCommand>, and probe and capture at the resolved address; a saved single-origin sign-in is re-pointed to the capture port; /spec:doctor check 19 (Fixed ports) flags loopback fixed ports in the config. Fixed-address hosts are unchanged. Grounding contract changed — hosts owe a /spec:doctor re-stamp.
